Class EventCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.TribeCard
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.model.EventCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
IDrawable
public class EventCard extends TribeCard
Event Card: it is resolved globally on all players during the end-of-round events phase. The numerical parameters (base food, aura per character, thresholds, bonus/malus) are interpreted by its own effect according to the event type.

    • getName

      public String getName()
      Returns the name of the event card. The name is generated as "Event-" + era. Used by the PersistenceManager to save the cards in the decks.
      Returns:
      card name (e.g. "Event-1", "Event-2")

    • matchesJobType

      public boolean matchesJobType(JobType jobType)
      Verifies if the event matches a given job (used by buildings that react only to the event of their type, e.g. Hunting or Cave Paintings).
      Parameters:
      jobType - the job to compare
      Returns:
      true if the event name matches the job

    • resolveEvent

      public void resolveEvent(Game g)
      Resolves the event applying its effects on the entire game. The effects internally iterate over all players, so here the Player is null; the card passes itself both as the owner card and as the current event.
      Parameters:
      g - the game on which to resolve the event

    • toClientString

      public String toClientString()
      Description copied from class: Card
      Returns a textual representation of the card for the Client. Each subclass produces a specific format with its own fields. Data is separated by '|' to ease client-side parsing.

      Returns:
